fun_facts: Stefon Diggs grew up in Olney, Maryland, and played high-school football at Good Counsel.
He was ESPN’s No. 13-ranked recruit in the 2012 class and chose nearby Maryland, in part to stay close to his family in Gaithersburg.
In three seasons at Maryland, Stefon Diggs caught 150 passes for 2,227 yards and 14 touchdowns; he ranks second in school history in receiving yards.
Stefon Diggs once threw the first pitch at a Baltimore Orioles game.
In one early NFL game against Kansas City, Stefon Diggs had seven catches for 129 yards.
Stefon Diggs has had seven 1,000-yard receiving seasons, made four Pro Bowls, and been named an All-Pro twice.
